author: Jordan B Peterson
description:
What does it mean to wrestle with God—and can anyone avoid it? In this lecture, Jordan Peterson takes up a question that reaches beyond the divide between believer and atheist. Drawing on ancient stories and his experience as a clinical psychologist, he explores faith, doubt, and what our choices reveal about what we believe.

Audience questions bring the discussion into the challenges of marriage, parenting, and maintaining discipline when life becomes difficult, connecting the evening’s larger questions to the demands of everyday life.

Recorded live in Phoenix on the We Who Wrestle With God tour.
